## Behavior

Problem, resulting behavior, requirement IDs, and change record.

## Verification

Commands actually run, outcomes, and missing evidence.

## Review

- [ ] Post-implementation code review completed; report linked.
- [ ] DB/API review and plans/load evidence included, or not-applicable reason given.
- [ ] Blocking findings fixed and affected changes re-reviewed.
- [ ] Contract, migrations, canonical specs, and task status match final code.

## Database and API impact

Affected routes/queries, cardinality, query counts, locks, indexes, pagination, latency, and migration/recovery implications. Omit irrelevant detail and explain any unmeasured claim.
